inputs: how do I fix a leaking tap

replies: A dripping tap is nearly always a worn washer or cartridge: turn the water off at the isolating valve under the sink, take the handle off, and take the old part to a hardware shop to match it. It's a 20-minute job and saves a lot of water.

inputs: how often should I water a cactus

replies: Water a cactus every two to three weeks in summer, and barely at all from November to March. Soak it, let it dry right out, and never leave the pot standing in water: more cacti die of watering than of neglect.
